transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 692 Barkerview Court?

You’re all good to go, no water inside. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?

Yeah, that’s right—just the four of us, no water in the house yet, and we’re all good here, no one needs to be left alone or anything.
Thanks for confirming everyone’s safe and accounted for. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
